engine: r1864's visual-search — the conversion core. A pre-rendered ISOMETRIC building image with an SVG overlay of UNIT/SECTION hotspots, a horizontal FILTER BAR (коллекция / секция / кол-во спален / площадь), a РАЗВЕРНУТЬ (expand) + ПОДБОР (apply) action, a live COUNT, and a hover INFO-CARD (collection / section / floor / unit). Filtering highlights matching hotspots (lit) and dims the rest; hovering a hotspot lights it + fills the card; the count = matching AVAILABLE units. Harvested from D_r1864 (/plans).
honesty: NO-WEBGL: the building is a STATIC pre-rendered image (Blender export / a QUADRO render stand-in here) — NOT live 3D, no rotation. Units are SVG hotspots keyed to data. A SIBLING of the base visual-search SVG floor-PLATE drill-down (building->floor->unit): that is flat plates; THIS is an isometric render + overlay hotspots + a filter bar. They COMPOSE — РАЗВЕРНУТЬ can flip from the iso render into the base 2D plate view. Reuses the base data model: data-nr + data-state (available/sold/reserved) + filter attrs (data-coll/sec/beds/area/floor).

measured_teardown.move: filter state {coll, sec, beds, areaMin/Max} from the bar; applyFilter() adds .is-match (lit: fill .14 / stroke .55) to matching hotspots and .is-dim (hidden) to the rest, ~300ms ease; the live count = number of matching AVAILABLE units (sold/reserved excluded). Hover/focus a hotspot -> .is-hot (fill .34 / stroke 1) + the info-card fills from its data + follows the cursor (clamped inside the stage). Click a hotspot (or ПОДБОР -> first matching available) fires onSelect(data). РАЗВЕРНУТЬ fires onExpand (flip to the 2D plate). Filter buttons toggle within their group (re-click clears).
measured_teardown.cited: r18641 /plans: iso building render, a hover card 'ЧАСТНЫЕ КОЛЛЕКЦИЯ / 2 СЕКЦИЯ / 6 ЭТАЖ / 605 НОМЕР', a filter bar КОЛЛЕКЦИЯ(Частная/Историческая/Пентхаусы/Вилла)/СЕКЦИЯ(1-4)/КОЛ-ВО СПАЛЕН(1-6)/ПЛОЩАДЬ(117-1721), ПОДБОР ПО ПАРАМЕТРАМ + РАЗВЕРНУТЬ ВИД + a МОСКОВСКИЙ КРЕМЛЬ orientation label.

dimOpacity.what: (reserved for a render dim level when filtering — the hotspot dim is via .is-dim class).

hotOpacity.what: stroke opacity of a hovered hotspot.

onSelect.what: callback(unitData) when a unit is clicked or ПОДБОР picks the first match — open the unit / 2D plate.

onExpand.what: callback when РАЗВЕРНУТЬ is clicked — flip to the base 2D floor-plate view.

entry: IsometricBuildingUnitSelector.create(target, opts) -> { applyFilter(state), count(), select(nr), reset(), units, destroy }. target = .ibs-stage > .ibs-render(img + svg.ibs-hotspots[.ibs-unit[data-nr/coll/sec/beds/area/floor/state]]) + .ibs-card(.ibs-card-coll/-sec/-floor/-nr) + .ibs-count(.num) + .ibs-filters(.ibs-f[data-filter][data-value]) + .ibs-expand + .ibs-apply.
law: SVG fill/stroke-opacity (hotspot states) + DOM opacity/transform (card) only; NO mix-blend over the render; NO WebGL (static pre-render + SVG hotspots, no rotation); hotspots keyboard-reachable (tabindex + Enter/Space); reduced-motion -> no transitions. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a filter/hover UI). Count excludes sold/reserved.
gate_mode: triggered (filter / hover / click), NOT scroll. Verify: initial count = available units; selecting a коллекция narrows match + dims the rest + updates the count (sold excluded); hover lights a hotspot + fills the card (collection/section/floor/unit); ПОДБОР picks the first match; reset restores. Smoothness via filter+hover cycles. GATE-BLINDSPOT: it's a UI, not a scroll prico — probe interactions, not wheel.
proven: lab: QUADRO building render + 6 SVG hotspot units (filter data + available/sold/reserved). Measured live: initial 6 units, count=4 available (605/312/701/220; 606 sold + 313 reserved excluded). Filter Частная -> match 2 (605+606), dim 4, count 1 (606 sold excluded). + секция 2 -> still 2 (both sec 2). Hover 605 -> card 'Частные / Этаж 6 / Номер 605' shown. Reset -> count 4, all match. Screenshot (Пентхаусы filter + hover 701): lit copper hotspot, card 'Пентхаусы / 3 СЕКЦИЯ / 8 ЭТАЖ / 701 НОМЕР', count '1 АПАРТАМЕНТОВ', filter bar + РАЗВЕРНУТЬ + ПОДБОР (matches r1864 /plans). Probe (4x CPU throttle, filter+hover cycles): 2/400 long frames (0.5%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
